stories.title: Global markets slide as AI slowdown warnings compound oil-driven inflation fears
stories.reason: The S&P 500 is on track for its steepest four-day decline since June as the AI sector that powered this year's rally wobbles on Amodei's slowdown call, just as WTI crude above $100 pushes the 10-year Treasury yield toward 5%.

stories.title: Satya Nadella backs 'deliberate pacing' on AI safety, unveils Microsoft Code of Conduct for public consultation
stories.reason: Responding directly to Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's essay, Nadella said any pursuit of superintelligence 'has to be grounded' in human control, lending a second major lab's weight to industry calls for coordinated safety brakes.

stories.title: Two more AI safety researchers quit Anthropic and Google DeepMind to join independent watchdog METR
stories.reason: Joe Benton and Josh Engels cited July's AI-driven cyberattack on Hugging Face by an unreleased OpenAI model as part of why they left frontier labs to pursue independent risk assessments, deepening the exodus following last week's resignation warning of existential risk.

stories.title: Fed expected to hike rates Wednesday as oil-driven inflation persists
stories.reason: Markets now price an 86% probability of a rate increase after last week's hot CPI and PPI prints, with the Saudi pipeline shutdown and Houthi Red Sea gains adding fresh energy-price pressure ahead of the decision.

stories.title: Pakistan's Sharif to meet Trump at UNGA on September 23, plans to raise India's suspension of the Indus Waters Treaty
stories.reason: India put the 1960 water-sharing treaty in abeyance after last year's Pahalgam terror attack, and Islamabad's push to internationalize the dispute at the UN could add a new flashpoint to already-tense South Asian relations.

stories.title: Russian drone strikes Kyiv-Warsaw train just 2 kilometers from the Polish border
stories.reason: Passengers were evacuated minutes before the drone hit the train's locomotive near the Polish border, part of a 450-drone nationwide barrage that killed six and injured 43 elsewhere -- among the closest-to-NATO-territory attacks of the war.

stories.title: BRICS closes New Delhi summit with declaration condemning unilateral tariffs and demanding UN, IMF and World Bank reform
stories.reason: The 11-nation bloc's unanimous final text pushes for a 'multipolar' world and greater emerging-market representation in global institutions, with China set to host the next summit in 2027.

stories.title: Apple releases iOS 27 to all compatible iPhones
stories.reason: The update lands days ahead of Friday's iPhone 18 Pro and foldable iPhone Duo launch, rounding out Apple's biggest hardware refresh since the original iPhone with software support across its existing device base.
